items.title: Mankind Pharma Q2 profit rises 38% to Rs 716 crore
items.description: Mankind Pharma has announced a profit increase of 37.7% to ₹716 crore during the September quarter. Revenue from operations rose to ₹4,337.9 crore compared to ₹3,697.2 crore in the same quarter last year. This growth is attributed to strong performance in both domestic and international markets. The recent acquisition of Armed Cell Therapeutics is expected to enhance R&D capabilities.

items.title: Tata consumer Q2 net profit up despite higher costs, weak tea demand
items.description: Tata Consumer Products encountered unchanged tea volumes and decreasing revenue in the September quarter as weak demand and surging commodity costs took their toll. To counter this, the company emphasized its salt business, which saw significant revenue increases driven by volume growth and price hikes. Meanwhile, international revenue held steady despite challenges in the UK market caused by weather issues.

items.title: Tata Capital Q2 Results: Profit jumps 51% to Rs 1,660 crore; NII up 23%
items.description: Tata Capital’s September-quarter net profit surged 51% year-on-year to Rs 1,660 crore, driven by loan growth, higher interest income and lower provisions. Its loan book crossed Rs 3 lakh crore, while improving margins and asset quality strengthened profitability.

items.title: Vedanta Iron Q2 Results: Loss narrows to Rs 324 crore, revenue declines 2% YoY
items.description: Vedanta Iron and Steel narrowed its Q2 FY27 loss to Rs 324 crore from Rs 477 crore a year earlier, while revenue declined 1.7% to Rs 2,742 crore. EBITDA rose 56% to Rs 83 crore, supported by improved steel realisations and efficiency gains. The company also reported record half-yearly pig iron production.

items.title: Larsen & Toubro Q2 Results: Profit surges 33% YoY to Rs 5,202 crore, revenue grows 16%
items.description: L&T Q2 Results: Larsen & Toubro announced significant financial results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. The company reported a 33% increase in consolidated profit after tax compared to the previous year. Consolidated revenue also grew by 16%, driven by strong performance across various sectors. Additionally, L&T achieved its highest quarterly order inflow and saw substantial international participation in its orders.

items.title: Raymond Q2 Results: Net profit jumps 130% YoY to Rs 32 crore, revenue rises 24%
items.description: Raymond reported a 130% year-on-year jump in consolidated net profit to Rs 32 crore in Q2 FY27, while revenue rose 24.1% to Rs 655 crore. EBITDA increased 74.4% to Rs 75 crore, with margins expanding 336 basis points to 11.5%. The company has also proposed a name change to Raymond Aerospace, Defence & Engineering.

items.title: WeWork India H1FY27 net profit rockets 150%, revenue surges 30%
items.description: WeWork India’s first-half FY27 net profit surged 149.5% to Rs 119 crore, while revenue grew 30.1% to Rs 1,466.7 crore. Capacity expansion, rising memberships, stronger cash flows and improved margins supported growth and strengthened its financial position.

items.title: WeWork India H1 net profit rises 150%, revenue up 30.1%
items.description: WeWork India reported a 149.5% year-on-year rise in first-half FY27 net profit to Rs 119 crore, while revenue grew 30.1% to Rs 1,466.7 crore. Capacity expansion, membership growth and improved operating margins supported performance. Operating cash flow strengthened, and the company shifted to a net cash position amid rising demand for flexible workspaces.

items.title: Maruti Suzuki Q2 Results: Profit falls 26% YoY to Rs 2,466 crore, but revenue rises 26%
items.description: In the July-September quarter, Maruti Suzuki India experienced a notable 26% decrease in net profit compared to last year. Still, revenue shot up by 26% year-on-year, totaling Rs 53,356 crore. Rising material and labor expenses grew total costs by about 30%, which hurt profit margins. Nonetheless, the company hit an impressive milestone with its highest quarterly sales volume of 6.97 lakh units.

items.title: Cipla Q2 net profit falls 35% to Rs 878 crore, revenue dips 2%
items.description: Cipla reported a 35% year-on-year decline in second-quarter net profit to Rs 878 crore, with revenue and EBITDA also falling amid weaker North American sales. India revenue grew 12%, while US regulatory approval and a biosimilar partnership supported its product pipeline.

items.title: Bajaj Auto Q2 Results: Profit jumps 35% YoY to Rs 3,354 crore; revenue up 34%
items.description: Bajaj Auto Q2 Results: Revenue grew 34% YoY to Rs 20,003 crore for the first time, doubling over the past three years. The company also reported EBITDA exceeding Rs 4,000 crore, a rise of over 37% from the year-ago period.

items.title: Cipla Q2 Results: Profit falls 35% YoY to Rs 878 crore; revenue slips 2%
items.description: Cipla reported a 35% drop in consolidated net profit for Q2FY27, which stood at Rs 878 crore. The company also experienced a 2.4% year-on-year decline in revenue from operations, totaling Rs 7,404 crore. Additionally, a significant 26.7% decrease in EBITDA resulted in a lower margin of 18.7%. Nonetheless, Cipla's One India division demonstrated growth across various segments, while the company aims to enhance productivity and innovate its product offerings.

items.title: Allied Blenders Q2 Results: Profit rises 9.7% to Rs 69 crore, revenue up 6.8%
items.description: Allied Blenders and Distillers reported a net profit increase of 9.7% in the September quarter of FY27. The company's revenue from operations rose by 6.8% compared to the previous fiscal year. Total expenses for the quarter were recorded at Rs 1,946.3 crore, reflecting a 6.51% rise. Total income, including other income, increased by 6.74% at Rs 2,089.46 crore in Q2 FY27. The shares of ABD closed at Rs 692.

items.title: Indus Towers Q2 Results: Net profit slips 2.5% to Rs 1,793 crore
items.description: Indus Towers reported a 2.5% decline in consolidated net profit for the second quarter ended September 30. The company experienced a 4% increase in consolidated revenue, while EBITDA saw a slight rise of 0.4%. Tower and co-location bases grew by 5.6% and 5.9%, respectively, contributing to improved performance. Strong customer demand and cash generation were highlighted as key growth drivers.

items.title: SAIL Q2 Results: Net profit surges four-fold to Rs 1750 crore on higher revenue
items.description: Steel Authority of India Ltd announced a significant increase in consolidated net profit for the September quarter. The company reported a profit of Rs 1,750.47 crore, a substantial rise from the previous year. Revenue from operations also saw growth, reaching Rs 31,997.55 crore compared to Rs 26,704.17 crore last year. Total expenses rose modestly to Rs 29,913.65 crore from Rs 26,113.64 crore.

items.title: United Breweries Q2 Results: Profit jumps nearly 3 times to Rs 134 crore on volume growth, premiumisation
items.description: United Breweries Ltd experienced a nearly three-fold increase in net profit for the September quarter. The company's revenue from operations rose by 23.7 percent year-on-year, reflecting strong market performance. Premium volumes notably surged, particularly for Heineken Silver and Kingfisher Ultra, enhancing UBL's premium offerings. Total expenses also increased, but operating efficiency and cost control contributed to profitability expansion. UBL remains optimistic about future growth opportunities in the Indian beer market.

items.title: SBI Life Insurance Q2 Results: Net profit grows 11% YoY to Rs 549 crore
items.description: SBI Life Insurance recorded an 11 percent increase in net profit for the second quarter. The net profit reached Rs 549 crore compared to Rs 495 crore last year. Additionally, the company’s net premium income grew by 8.17 percent to Rs 26,877 crore. This increase in profit and income highlights the company’s strong financial performance in the current fiscal year. Shares of SBI Life closed at Rs 1,634.

items.title: Tata Capital Q2 net profit rises 51% on higher income
items.description: Tata Capital’s second-quarter net profit rose 51% year-on-year to Rs 1,660 crore, supported by higher interest income and loan growth. Assets under management increased 26% to Rs 3.08 lakh crore, while floating-rate lending adjustments and margin improvement remain key priorities.

items.title: Waaree Energies Q2 Results: Profit falls 15% YoY to Rs 719 crore, revenue rises 24%
items.description: Waaree Energies reported a 14.7% year-on-year profit decline to Rs 718.68 crore in Q2FY27, despite 23.9% revenue growth. Margin pressure persisted as the company acquired data centre subsidiaries, exploring diversification into AI and digital infrastructure.

items.title: RIL to announce Q2 results on October 30, board to also consider fundraising
items.description: Reliance Industries will announce its September-quarter results on October 30, alongside considering fundraising through non-convertible debentures. Investors will track performance across O2C, telecom, retail and energy businesses amid share price weakness and market uncertainty.

items.title: JSW Infrastructure Q2 Results: Net profit falls 11% to Rs 328 crore
items.description: JSW Infrastructure reported an 11 percent drop in consolidated net profit for the September quarter, with earnings falling to Rs 328.23 crore from Rs 368.81 crore the previous year. The company achieved total income of Rs 1,669.47 crore, while expenses rose to Rs 1,238.34 crore. Notably, cargo volumes from India operations grew by 8 percent year-on-year, reaching 29.4 million tonnes.
